|ingredients = {{Name|Wheat Flour|1}} }} '''Bread''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using [[Wheat Flour]] made in the [[Mill]]. Bread is available at [[the Stardrop Saloon]] every day for {{Price|120}}, and randomly from [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. It can also be found in [[Garbage Can]]s. One Bread can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].
